question: The average age of 26 students of a class is 43 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 44 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the net deviation method for averages:

Age of new member = Old average + (Total members × Increase in average)

Age of teacher = 43 + (27 × 1)

Age of teacher = 43 + 27 = 70

**∴ The correct answer is 70 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 26

Average age of students = 43 years

New average age (including teacher) = 44 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 
 26 Students (Avg: 43)
 +
 
 Teacher
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 27 Members (New Avg: 44)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 26 students = 26 × 43

⇒ Total age of 26 students = 1118 years

⇒ Total number of people after including the teacher = 26 + 1 = 27

⇒ Total age of 27 people = 27 × 44

⇒ Total age of 27 people = 1188 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 27 people − Total age of 26 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 1188 − 1118 = 70

**∴ The correct answer is 70 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ having n₁ and n₂ elements respectively are mixed, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Excluding a Member

If a member leaves a group, the value of the excluded member is Old Average − (Remaining Members × Decrease in Average).

Replacement in Average

When one person is replaced by another, the age of the new person = Age of removed person + (Total members × Change in Average).
